proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ X c ε h hε
  have h1 := h.measure_ge_le hε
  have h2 := h.neg.measure_ge_le hε
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  have hsub : {ω | ε ≤ |X ω|} ⊆ {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ∪ {ω | ε ≤ (-X) ω} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union, Pi.neg_apply] at hω ⊢
    exact le_abs.mp hω
  calc P.real {ω | ε ≤ |X ω|} ≤ P.real ({ω | ε ≤ X ω} ∪ {ω | ε ≤ (-X) ω}) := MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hsub (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _)
    _ ≤ P.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} + P.real {ω | ε ≤ (-X) ω} := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : Ω → ℝ) (c : NNReal) (ε : ℝ), ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF X c P → 0 ≤ ε → P.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ≤ Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (c : ℝ))) ∧ P.real {ω | ε ≤ |X ω|} ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * (c : ℝ)))
